label: Bible Study
prompt: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put _____.
verse: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
note: Jesus on marriage, right after quoting Genesis 2 — what God joins, people shouldn't pull apart.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the _____ that is higher than I.
verse: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
note: From the end of the earth, heart overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Do thy diligence to come before _____. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verse: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
note: Paul, a prisoner, asks Timothy to hurry and 'come before winter' — perhaps he wanted that cloke.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But they _____ the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
verse: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
note: Why Jerusalem fell: Judah mocked the very messengers God sent to warn them, until there was no remedy.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their _____.
verse: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.
note: Ezekiel's hearers enjoyed him like a lovely song (33:32) — but their hearts went after 'covetousness.' Hearers, not doers.
